agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
October 2, 2019 7:00 P.M.
Community Room – First Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
 ----------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to
  address the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda
  other than a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for March 12, 2019 Special
  Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Alexis
  Lewis representing East Beach Inglewood, LLC for Zone
  Change No. 2019-001 (ZC-2019-001) to allow a zone change
  of an approximately 67,738 square-foot (1.55 acres) site
  from R-2 (Limited-Multiple family Residential) and M-1
  (Light  Manufacturing)  to  R-3  (Multiple-family
  Residential) at 355 La Colina Drive and 338 to 358 East
  Beach Avenue.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Addendum
  to Environmental Impact Report EA-EIR-2016-022;
  and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt a resolution
  recommending City Council adoption of Zone
  Change ZC-2019-001.

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Matt
  Budney, representing 7-Eleven, for Special Use Permit No.
  2019-010 (SP-2019-010) to allow 1) an automobile service
  station and 2) the sale of beer and wine for off-site
  consumption from a proposed convenience market on an
  approximately 23,100 square-foot, C-2 (General Commercial)
  zoned property at 1500-1502 North La Brea Avenue.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Notice
  of Exemption EA-CE-2019-100; and
  b. Make  a  determination  on  whether  Public
  Convenience or Necessity is served by this
  request; and
  c. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt Findings and
  the attached resolution approving SP-2019-010
  subject to conditions.
 7.  NON - PUBLIC HEARINGS
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by
  Elliott Weinstock representing 111 North La Brea Plaza,
  LLC. for Design Review No. 2019-007 (DR-2019-007) to
  allow exterior improvements to an existing 8-story office
  building on an approximately 19,800 square-foot, H-C
  (Historic Core) zoned property at 101 North La Brea
  Avenue.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary  CEQA  Recommendation:  Affirm
  Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2019-093; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt a resolution
  recommending adoption of DR-2019-007.

  b. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Elliott
  Weinstock representing 111 North La Brea Plaza, LLC. for
  Design Review No. 2019-009 (DR-2019-009) to allow exterior
  improvements to an existing 8-story office building on an
  approximately 21,000 square-foot, H-C (Historic Core)
  zoned property at 111 North La Brea Avenue.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary  CEQA  Recommendation:  Affirm
  Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2019-112; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt a resolution
  recommending adoption of DR-2019-009.

8.  Strategic Plan for Economic Development: Presentation by
  Sharon Mann Garrett, Economic Development Manager.

9.  Commission Initiatives

10.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

11.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor,  Inglewood City Hall,
Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations
must be received 48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información,
favor de llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of October 2,
2019 is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or
other agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-
public hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to
the next regular Planning Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2019, 7:00 P.M.
  COMMUNITY ROOM, FIRST FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
